decode_video_frames: decode a video using pyav or torchvision backend and return temporally sampled frames as a tensor
temporal_sampling_frames: sample a fixed number of frames from a video tensor at equal temporal intervals
pyav_decode_selective: decode a video with PyAV using selective decoding to extract a clip at the target FPS
torchvision_decode_selective: decode a video with TorchVision using selective decoding and video metadata for efficient frame extraction
get_clip_start_end_idx: calculate the start and end frame indices for a clip using random or uniform sampling strategy
